plan_review.notes: Alt A render-only footprints over GoreVfx pools rejected because it weakens deterministic sim/test coverage and leaves no authoritative runtime state. Alt B sim-owned pools rendered by GoreVfx adopted because it removes the dead parallel path and guarantees pool contact, footprint color, and visible pool lifetime/position stay in sync. Addressed concerns by making world blood pools authoritative, pinning shared color/lifetime helpers, defining deterministic contact/mixing rules, and planning real MainGameScene probe evidence.

rounds.notes: Final code-review pass after pool-contact, teleport-gap, intensity-zero, and stride-smear fixes found no validated issues.

Validated and fixed four issues: teleport trail backfill after large jumps, per-frame footprint geometry redraw, visible/contact blood-pool mismatch, and intensity=0 still rendering authoritative pools.

A follow-up review surfaced one additional valid issue: smear intensity ignored the real stride distance because only fixed 0.42-ft segments reached the footprint builder. Fixed by threading strideDistanceFt through bloodyFootprintSystem into createBloodFootprintSurface.
Both review models were clean after the final fixes; adjudicator confirmed no unresolved multi-model concern remains.
